notes: Source 4 = Netzer 1975, Qadmoniot 8 (Hebrew); quotes are from the packet's English translation. No plan position: neither plan carries grid coordinates, so the unit's recorded point (190500/139050) cannot be placed on it. The general plan (p. 55) has a north arrow about 45-48 deg clockwise of page-up and a 0-25 scale bar; plan p. 59 has no north arrow. Directions are taken from the text. Summit features lie in 'the north-western corner of the summit' (bathhouse, p. 56). The Hasmonean pool and cistern lie under the tepidarium of that bathhouse (caption p. 58). Lower-terrace bathhouse pools are in 'the north-eastern corner' of the terrace (pp. 59-60). These directions are given from part of the site (the summit or the terrace), so relative_to is 'other'. The terrace lies SE of the summit (p. 56). On the p. 55 plan the lower bathhouse looks roughly E-ENE of the drawing's overall centre. That is not measured from the unit point and is not coded. The 'four cisterns at the foot of the hill' are on the east of Cypros (p. 61), relative to the site. pool_def 'yes' for the stepped immersion pools because the source calls them pools (breikha). The summit frigidarium pool measures 1.5 x 3.5 m. Not recorded: bathtubs (2.05 x 1.10 m and a later plastered tub), a 1.4 m marble labrum (vat-like fixtures, not pools), and the aqueduct bringing Wadi Qelt water to the foot of the hill (p. 54). The photo caption p. 60 'two pools of the caldarium' is taken to be the same two frigidarium pools (s4f7-8). The publication has no passage on graves or burials. That is silence, not a stated absence, so no explicit_absence is recorded.
